title: A Warm Light
prompt: A soft light gathers in your palms while you play. It does not burn. It waits.

journal: The light sank into me. The world hummed once.
It slipped away. My hands shook for an hour.

choices.label: Pull away
journal: I closed my fists. Ordinary felt safer today.

choices.label: Show a parent
journal: Their eyes went wide. Lessons would follow.

title: First Word
prompt: Everyone leans in. Your mouth finds a shape.

choices.label: Say a parent's name
journal: They laughed and cried at once.

choices.label: Say a nonsense sound
journal: I invented a word. It stuck for years.

choices.label: Point at the dog
journal: The dog became family canon.

title: Stick and Dignity
prompt: A fallen branch is clearly a blade. Clearly.

choices.label: Spar the fence post
journal: The fence post lost. Eventually.

choices.label: Knight a sibling
journal: A solemn ceremony. Mostly giggling.

choices.label: Get told off and hide it
journal: I learned where the floorboards creak.

title: Academy Gate
prompt: The examiner asks why you belong inside. Your answer matters more than your age.

choices.label: Recite a charm
journal: The examiner raised one eyebrow. Then a pen.

choices.label: Admit you are scared but ready
journal: Honesty opened the gate wider than talent.

choices.label: Name a sponsor
journal: A name, a nod, a seal. Court doors creaked.

choices.label: Walk away
journal: Some gates can wait.

title: Which Way the Blade
prompt: Three instructors wait. None will teach the same path.

choices.label: Steady Guard
journal: I chose the path that felt like breathing.

choices.label: Swift Cut
journal: Speed over comfort.

choices.label: Heavy Cleaver
journal: Weight that ends arguments.

title: Road Tax
prompt: Rope across the path. Three voices asking for "toll."

journal: Three voices became three running footsteps.
I kept my purse and lost some blood.

choices.label: Pay
journal: Gold bought quiet. It always does, briefly.
A raised palm and a hum of mana. They chose to believe me.
They laughed. I paid double.

choices.label: Slip into brush
journal: Thorns are cheaper than toll.

title: Posted Beast
prompt: A pelt sketch and a heavy purse. The shepherd is already gone.

journal: I brought back the pelt. The purse was heavier than it looked.
The beast chose the ground. I limped home.

choices.label: Hire help
journal: Shared purse, shared scars, fewer of them.

choices.label: Track and report to rangers
journal: The rangers paid in thanks and dried fruit.

title: Formal Steel
prompt: A glove in the dirt. Witnesses. No good way to laugh this off.

journal: First blood, mine. The crowd remembered my name.
I yielded with a split brow and my pride in pieces.

choices.label: Negotiate terms
journal: A sparring bout instead. Both of us kept our teeth.

choices.label: Refuse
journal: Whispers followed me for a season.

title: Eyes in the Dark
prompt: Five shapes circling the camp. The fire is getting low.

journal: By dawn the howling had moved to the next valley.
Teeth found my leg before the fire found them.

choices.label: Build the fire higher
journal: I fed it everything I owned that burned.

choices.label: Climb a tree
journal: A long night. A stiff morning.

title: Broken Watch
prompt: Stones lean like tired men. Something glints under moss.

journal: An old signet ring. Someone was important once.
A stone gave way. So did my ankle.

choices.label: Sketch the map
journal: Lines on paper; the tower lives in my Codex now.

choices.label: Leave offerings and go
journal: Some places want to be left alone.

title: Water Over Stone
prompt: A shrine roof shows through the pool. Coins glitter wrong.

journal: Cold to the bone, a small bronze charm in my fist.
The water held on. I came up coughing and empty-handed.

choices.label: Pray from the bank
journal: The ripples stilled. I felt answered, a little.

choices.label: Mark it on your Codex
journal: Another page filled.

title: Wagon With No Road
prompt: A merchant with a painted wagon sells maps of places that do not exist. Yet.

choices.label: Buy a map (20 gold)
journal: The ink moved when I was not looking.

choices.label: Haggle for fun
journal: He laughed and gave me a tea leaf for my trouble.

choices.label: Walk on
journal: When I looked back, the road was empty.

title: Over the Next Hill
prompt: Caravan bells, a fork in the trail, and a sign you have never read before.

choices.label: Follow the new road
journal: New air, new faces, new prices.

choices.label: Not this year
journal: Home pulled harder than the horizon.

title: The Stair Under the Mill
prompt: A stair under the mill. Cold air. Old blood smell.

choices.label: Go down
journal: I lit a torch and counted the steps.

choices.label: Report it to the guild
journal: The guild board posted it. Someone else went down.

title: First Floor
prompt: Torches that should not still burn.

choices.label: Press on
journal: The torches leaned toward me as I passed.

choices.label: Turn back
journal: Not today.

title: Trap Hall
prompt: Pressure plate. You notice — or you don't.

journal: I noticed.
I didn't.

choices.label: Turn back
journal: The plate clicked behind me anyway. I ran.

title: Sealed Chamber
prompt: Something that kept the stair sealed on purpose.

journal: It fell. The silence after was enormous.
I barely made the stair.

choices.label: Seal it again
journal: Some doors are shut for good reasons.

title: Wrapped Thing
prompt: A wrapped thing that knows your name.

choices.label: Take it
journal: It was warm, like it had been waiting.

choices.label: Leave it
journal: I left it wrapped. It let me.

title: An Older Hand
prompt: Someone who already survived your mistakes offers to teach you.

choices.label: Accept apprenticeship
journal: Mornings got earlier. I got better.

choices.label: Ask the price first
journal: Tea and chores. A fair price.

choices.label: Decline kindly
journal: They nodded like they had expected it.

title: Lantern Dance
prompt: Music, tea steam, a hand held out.

choices.label: Dance
journal: Lanterns, laughter, and someone new to think about.

choices.label: Watch from the wall
journal: The music was enough.

choices.label: Broker introductions
journal: Two friends of mine left holding hands.

title: A Quiet Ask
prompt: Not a festival. Just two cups and a question that changes the house.

choices.label: Yes
journal: Two cups, one house.

choices.label: Not yet
journal: They said they would ask again. I hoped they would.

choices.label: No
journal: The tea went cold between us.

title: A New Voice
prompt: A new life joins your line.

choices.label: Hold them close
journal: Tiny fingers, enormous grip.

title: A Child With No Name Left
prompt: A child with no name left. Yours could fit.

choices.label: Take them home
journal: The house got louder. Better.

choices.label: Find them a place at the shrine
journal: The keeper promised to look after them.

title: Talent, Debt and Drama
prompt: Talent, debt and drama in one package.

choices.label: Take them on
journal: Someone to inherit what my hands know.

choices.label: Not now
journal: They found another master. I wondered.

title: Same Board, Same Bounty
prompt: Someone your age keeps taking the jobs you wanted.

choices.label: Train harder
journal: Nothing motivates like a smug face.

choices.label: Offer a truce
journal: Rivals make strange friends.

title: Rank Board
prompt: The examiners do not smile. Your last year of work sits on the table.

journal: They stamped the seal without a word. That was the praise.
Not this year. They wrote down why.

choices.label: Cite deeds
journal: They listened. They took notes. They promised nothing.
The seal arrived. My conscience did not sleep well.
They took the purse and my name went on a different list.

choices.label: Wait another year
journal: Patience is a skill too.

title: Masterwork Ask
prompt: A noble wants something only your hammer should touch. One month.

choices.label: Overwork alone
journal: My arms ached for weeks. The blade sang.

choices.label: Share with an apprentice
journal: Half the gold, twice the teaching.

choices.label: Refuse
journal: Nobles remember a no.

title: Empty Wagons
prompt: News arrives before the dust does. Your goods did not.

journal: We got most of it back, and a story.
Dust and nothing else.

choices.label: File a claim
journal: Ledger Hall stamped it. Payment: someday.

choices.label: Eat the loss and raise prices
journal: Customers grumbled. The ledger healed.

title: The Ward Fills
prompt: Cots in the hall. Not enough salve. Someone has to choose who waits.

choices.label: Work until you drop
journal: I slept on the floor between cots. Most of them lived.

choices.label: Ration fairly
journal: Fair is not kind. It was the best I had.

choices.label: Call the shrine for help
journal: The keepers came with tea and steady hands.

title: A Seat by the Fire
prompt: A sealed note: sing for people who can end you with a shrug.

journal: They did not shrug. They clapped.
A string snapped. So did the mood.

choices.label: Send a student
journal: My student came back glowing. Good.

choices.label: Decline
journal: Some fires are too warm.

title: Black Leaves
prompt: Half the field spots overnight. Neighbors watch your gate.

choices.label: Burn the rows
journal: Smoke all day. The rest of the field lived.

choices.label: Call a healer/priest
journal: A blessing, a tonic for the soil, a small bill.

choices.label: Sell what you can now
journal: Half price is better than none.

title: Whispers on Silver Trays
prompt: A letter that was not meant for you is now in your sleeve.

choices.label: Deliver it unread
journal: Loyalty is a currency too.

choices.label: Read it
journal: Now I know too much.

choices.label: Burn it
journal: Ash keeps secrets best.

title: Something at the Grave
prompt: A wrapped blade that was not there yesterday.

choices.label: Take for heir
journal: I took it home. It felt like a handshake.

choices.label: Leave it
journal: Some gifts belong to the dead.

choices.label: Bury deeper
journal: The earth closed over it. Quiet.

title: A Life Behind the Eyes
prompt: For a breath, you remember a skill you have not learned yet — or already did.

choices.label: Embrace it
journal: My hands knew the motion before I did.

choices.label: Shake it off
journal: This life is mine.

choices.label: Write it in the Codex
journal: Ink keeps what memory loses.

title: First Year With Their Name
prompt: The house still smells like them. The ledgers do not care.

choices.label: Keep their craft
journal: Their tools fit my hands, almost.

choices.label: Sell what hurts
journal: Gold does not grieve. I did.

choices.label: Visit the grave weekly
journal: Flowers, tea, a long talk.

title: A Small Life
prompt: A cat in a drainpipe. Dignity in ruins.

choices.label: Free it
journal: Scratched, muddy, adored.

choices.label: Feed it
journal: It followed me home. It lives here now.

choices.label: Walk on
journal: The mewing followed me all day.

title: Unasked Blessing
prompt: The keeper presses a charm into your hand. No price named.

choices.label: Accept
journal: The charm hums on cold nights.

choices.label: Leave tea and coin
journal: The keeper smiled like I had passed a test.

choices.label: Refuse politely
journal: The keeper bowed. So did I.

title: Dream That Sticks
prompt: A road, a gate, a face you have not met. Morning does not erase it.

choices.label: Chase the road
journal: I packed a bag before breakfast.

choices.label: Tell a priest
journal: They wrote it down. They did not laugh.

choices.label: Ignore it
journal: It came back three nights running.

title: Dust on the East Road
prompt: Dust on the east road. Too much dust.

choices.label: Warn the watch
journal: The bell rang twice that week.

choices.label: Stock up and wait
journal: Barrels of grain, shutters nailed.

title: Horns
prompt: Horns. The guild board rewrites itself overnight.

journal: We held. My name is on a list at the watchpost now.
The wall held. I nearly did not.

choices.label: Shelter the young
journal: Thirty children in a cellar, and a lot of stories.

choices.label: Flee the vale
journal: I lived. Not everyone forgave me.

title: Fever Season
prompt: Half the lane is coughing. Now you are too.

choices.label: Visit the apothecary (10 gold)
journal: Bitter tonic. Sweet relief.

choices.label: Rest it out
journal: Three days of soup and ceiling.

title: Slow Mornings
prompt: The stairs are longer than they used to be.

choices.label: Take a herbal tonic
journal: Ginger root and stubbornness.

choices.label: Teach the young instead
journal: My hands are slow. My advice is not.
